title: Captain Shubman Gill overtakes Virat Kohli in latest ICC ODI rankings
summary: In a remarkable turn of events, Shubman Gill now ranks second in the ICC ODI batting rankings, overtaking fellow Indian star Virat Kohli, who drops to third. Gill showcased his exceptional skills versus Afghanistan, scoring a century and claiming Player of the Series honors.
title_hi: ICC Rankings: वनडे रैंकिंग में गिल की लंबी छलांग, कोहली को पीछे छोड़ा; बुमराह की बराबरी पर पहुंचे मैट हेनरी
